source_window.selection_rule: Current canonical Primary sources with prior_review_exposure=0 that received explicit source-level review in the 2026-08-24 contradiction/reopen audit.

sources.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
sources.note: The source directly supports project-specific external diagnostic memory and internal intervention-memory ablations, but it is only one component of PORT-017. It does not repair the missing aligned SkillEvo endpoint or the required third independent entity-level intervention-knowledge mechanism.

sources.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
sources.note: Freezing the environment designer while removing its memory changes multiple adaptation inputs at once. The observed below-base collapse is already explained by compound distributional mismatch/negative transfer absent a same-information residual.

sources.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
sources.note: Persistent specialist autonomy is valuable when its one-time promotion cost is amortized by repeated future service. The observed break-even is not a new phase transition without a matched non-amortization state variable.

sources.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
sources.note: The paper supplies source-faithful faulty-agent/error-type attribution evidence, but not matched observable units requiring incompatible correct repairs. It therefore does not satisfy the SHADOW-P03 identifiability reopen contract.

sources.title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents
sources.note: Improved safe success together with reduced excess authority is evidence that task-conditioned least privilege can satisfy a constrained utility objective. The result does not expose an irreducible self-evolution failure beyond the existing safety/utility constraint formulation.

sources.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
sources.note: Trajectory-level evolution-strategy optimization under sparse terminal reward is a useful method/capability result, but canonical closures do not assert that long-horizon agent adaptation requires step-level or process-level credit. No existing opposite prediction is contradicted.

sources.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
sources.note: The same threshold-constrained formulation transfers across cost, safety, formatting, over-refusal, privacy, and instruction-following constraints. This reinforces rather than contradicts the canonical constrained-optimization reduction.

sources.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
sources.note: Persistent failures on spatial quantities and long underspecified 3D instructions are real capability boundaries, but the source does not isolate a longitudinal self-evolution mechanism or matched update-history residual.

sources.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems
sources.note: Failed-state contamination motivates transactional isolation, while confidence-triggered retry thresholds trade unnecessary retry against failure propagation. The retry threshold itself remains standard cost-sensitive operating-point selection under matched costs/confidence.

sources.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
sources.note: Multi-turn feedback supplies a strong evolution-gradient effect and a clear feedback-source ablation, but the source does not define the same entity-level intervention-knowledge endpoint as SkillForge. It therefore cannot complete PORT-017's frozen convergent-failure support contract.
